notes.title: Sayonara Umihara Kawase Time Attack Contest
notes.notes:
Spring is finally here, so let’s enjoy the weather warming up with Sayonara Umihara Kawase! We’re having a time attack contest for Stage 6 of the game! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10204877/f8d86ec39dfafbef458e75ed22579a1fd156c34e.png[/img]

The contest will run from [u]March 27th at 10am PT to April 3rd at 10am PT.[/u] Here’s how you enter…

[olist][*]On the game’s title or map screen, press start to access the game menu and choose “Settings”. 
[*]Make sure all of these options are enabled... 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10204877/85646f8904b08431051fda84b92bf592e87e720c.jpg[/img]
[*]Reach Stage 6 if you haven’t already and complete it as fast as possible,  with [i]adult Kawase[/i] (default main character). [b]You MUST pick up the backpack![/b]
[*]On the game’s title or map screen, press start to access the game menu and choose “Replay”. 
[*]Hit the right bumper (R1) button on your controller and choose your best completed Stage 6 time.
[*]Choose “Save this Replay Data”.
[*]In the “Save Data” screen, choose your newly saved replay and rename it to “DC” (for Degica Contest) plus the seconds and hundredths of a second of your time. For example, if you completed the stage in 42 and a half seconds, call the replay “DC 42.50”.
[*]Choose your newly renamed replay, scroll to the left, choose “Upload”, and confirm the upload.
[*]Go to your Steam Workshop page, and set the replays “Visibility” to “Public”.[/olist]

[i]Caution!: The replay log will disappear when you quit the game. Please save the log data before you quit![/i]

In order to be counted, [b]replays must be submitted during the contest period.[/b] The top five fastest submitted replays [b]that also pick up the backpack[/b] in Stage 6 will win the following prizes based on their placement…

[olist][*]Umihara Kawase exclusive T-shirt + $10 Steam wallet credit
[*]Original wrist rest pillow + $10 Steam wallet credit
[*]Original Notepad + $10 Steam wallet credit
[*]$10 Steam wallet credit
[*]$5 Steam wallet credit[/olist]

Also, we will be holding a special Umihara Twitch stream event at [b]6pm PT on March 29th![/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10204877/a96dea9474fddc74bc6961d11c02b25bbb2c6350.png[/img]
https://www.twitch.tv/degigames
Don't miss the chance to ask your questions directly to the developer, [i]Mr. Kondou[/i]. The broadcast will be in English with the bilingual streaming idol, [i]kson[/i]!

Good luck, and enjoy the fishin’!

notes.title: Umihara grapples its way back onto Steam!
notes.notes:
Fans asked, and we've delivered! Umihara Kawase Trilogy’s wonderfully bizarre fishing/grappling-hook platforming was missing from Steam... and now it’s back! 

Umihara Kawase Trilogy features Umihara Kawase, Umihara Kawase Shun Steam Edition, and Sayonara Umihara Kawase. These three puzzle/platformer games tell the tale of a girl named Umihara Kawase who uses a fishing hook as a grappling hook. You’ll need quick reflexes to swing your way through the branching surreal environments. Use your brains to figure out the best way through. They say fish is brain food. You’re going to need it! 

For more news on games like Umihara, please follow us: 
https://twitter.com/DegiGames 
https://www.facebook.com/pages/DegiGames/706894756072949 

You'll get hooked, 
Degica

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Sayonara UmiharaKawase, 15% off!
notes.notes:
Sayonara UmiharaKawase is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

Play as `Umihara Kawase` - a 20 year old backpacking Japanese sushi chef armed with a fishing rod, a rubber fishing line and a fishing hook. Avoid fish-like enemies, conveyer belts, spikes, watery pits, time travel and more.

*Offer ends October 12 at 10AM Pacific Time
